reasoning: Count paths ending at each new vertex modulo2. Its parity is1 xor incoming opposite-color odd-ending-path contributions. If any opposite odd predecessor exists, incoming-edge choices split equally between both parities; otherwise parity must be1. Same-color and even-contribution edges remain freely selectable. Eight DP states track existence of odd-ending paths for each color and total parity; unknown colors are summed explicitly. Exact modulo arithmetic; O(n).
